name: Canadian Provinces and Territories
description: Every province and territory by its two-letter code, its English name, its French name where that differs, with no commas, and by older and informal abbreviations. Shapes follow Canada Post's Addressing Guidelines, described in our own words; every input is constructed for this corpus, and no table is copied from Canada Post.
